instruction: Grab the black and white plastic microphone from the table and pass it across.

source.instruction: Grab the black and white plastic microphone from the table and pass it across.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the RIGHT arm grasped the microphone, which was at x = +15 (right half of the table); the LEFT arm grasped the microphone, which was at x = -1 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right arm closer to microphone, orient gripper horizontally, and descend slightly.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-16, +13, -9) cm, now 4 cm (horizontal) / +11 cm (vertical) from the microphone

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (15, -6, 85) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right arm to z=77.5 cm and close gripper to grasp the microphone.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, +1, -7) cm, now 2 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the microphone; closed the gripper (opening 0.25: holding the microphone)

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (15, -5, 78) opening 0.25; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift microphone up to z=90 cm, move inwards towards x=6 cm, and point forward.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-10, +6, +12) cm, now 4 cm (horizontal) / -2 cm (vertical) from the microphone

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (6, 1, 90) opening 0.25; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate right arm yaw by 45 degrees, lift further to z=101 cm, and adjust xy position.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, +11) cm, now 4 cm (horizontal) / -2 cm (vertical) from the microphone

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (6, 1, 101) opening 0.25; table z = 74
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips stayed in place, now 4 cm (horizontal) / -2 cm (vertical) from the microphone

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (6, 1, 101) opening 0.25; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right gripper back and left to (2, -7, 104) and adjust pitch for handover.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-4, -7, +3) cm, now 4 cm (horizontal) / -2 cm (vertical) from the microphone

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (2, -7, 104) opening 0.25; table z = 74
frames.plan: Fine-adjust right gripper roll and position.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips stayed in place, now 4 cm (horizontal) / -2 cm (vertical) from the microphone

frames.label: turn 8
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (2, -7, 104) opening 0.25; table z = 74
frames.plan: Raise left arm to z=100 cm, rotate yaw -45 degrees, and move towards center (x=-18 cm).
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+12, +0, +6) cm, now 23 cm (horizontal) / -6 cm (vertical) from the microphone

frames.label: turn 9
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-18, -19, 100) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (2, -7, 104) opening 0.25; table z = 74
frames.plan: Advance left gripper diagonally towards microphone around (-7, -12, 108).
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+11, +7, +8) cm, now 10 cm (horizontal) / +2 cm (vertical) from the microphone

frames.label: turn 10
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-7, -12, 108) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (2, -7, 104) opening 0.25; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left gripper forward and right closer to microphone handle.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+3, +3, +0) cm, now 6 cm (horizontal) / +2 cm (vertical) from the microphone

frames.label: turn 11
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-4, -9, 109) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (2, -7, 104) opening 0.23; table z = 74

frames.label: turn 12
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-1, -5, 110) opening 0.92; RIGHT fingertips (3, -6, 104) opening 0.20; table z = 74
frames.plan: Fine adjust left arm position down to z=108 cm and roll to center grip.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +1, -0) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the microphone

frames.label: turn 13
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-1, -5, 110) opening 0.92; RIGHT fingertips (3, -5, 104) opening 0.24; table z = 74
frames.plan: Close left gripper completely to take hold of microphone.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +2 cm (vertical) from the microphone; closed the gripper (opening 0.28: holding the microphone)

frames.label: turn 14
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-1, -5, 110) opening 0.28; RIGHT fingertips (3, -5, 104) opening 0.00; table z = 74
frames.plan: Open right gripper to complete the pass across.
